01 / THE PROCESS

A port is more than
a translation.

Keep the original as the reference. Rebuild one observable piece at a time.

01

Inspect the original

Pin the build. Read the formats. Run the program. When only a binary exists, use REA to recover evidence.

survey → reference.lock
02

Make a real slice

Load an original map, execute a vehicle script, or round-trip a save. Connect the actual runtime early.

content → core → frame
03

Measure the match

Feed the same inputs to both sides. Compare state, files and frames. Keep unknowns in the ledger.

original ↔ Rust → diff
